product_metadata.title: Cherrypark High Stretch Couch Cover for 2 Cushion Couch Universal Waterproof 2 Seat Sofa Covers Non Slip Sofa Slipcovers with Elastic Hem Living Room Furniture Protector (Medium, Black)
features: 1.WATERPROOF FEATURE: All of our sofa covers are made of high quality, water-resistant fabric that are durable and can make your furniture fresher and tidy. The upgraded waterproof fabric of the magic sofa cover features a water repellent and stain resistant finish, providing a full protaction against any accidental spills. Accidental splashing will form water droplets on the surface of the sofa slipcover, you don't have to worry about staining your sofa if you wipe it off immediately.

2.HIGH STRECH FABRIC: Our couch cover for 1/2/3/4 cushion couch are made of stretchy 85% polyester and 15% spandex blend fabric with a soft texture for a luxury look, which also make our fitted sofa protectors best suitable for many types of sofas. Our sofa slipcovers can instantly put family rooms and living rooms in a vacation state of mind which also brings feeling of breathable, skin-friendly, smooth and soft to the touch.

3.STYLISH: Get a new look for your sofa with these magic sofa covers. Cherrypark sofa slipcovers are designed in full solid color, which can complement any decoration of your room and add elegance to your furniture and home decoration. This couch cover uses environmentally friendly dyeing, which is environmentally friendly and not easy to fade. The vibrant colors will last for a long time and add a unique and luxurious atmosphere to your living room.

4.EASY TO USE: The detailed picture of our sofa cover includes the installation drawing, and we also put the installation guide in the package. Just follow them and you can install these slipcovers effortlessly by yourself in ten minutes. You can choose either machine wash or hand wash. Use gentle water for machine wash or hand wash. Tumble dry or line dry. Note: Please be careful that these sofa covers cannot be ironed or bleached.

5.SIZE CHOOSE: In order to choose the right size for your sofa, please measure your furniture size before ordering.X-Large size can fit the length between 92-118 inches, Large size can fit the length between 72-92 inches, Medium size can fit the length between 57-70 inches while small size can fit the length between 32-47 inches. Normally you will enjoy our pet furniture protectors, while if you have any concerns or you just want to return, please feel free to send email to us on Amazon.
